Consensus m/z contract

Source: R/consensus.R
consensus-mz-contract.Rd

All consensus-m/z closures in this package share one signature so they are drop-in replaceable in process_pseudo_spec():

Details


  function(mz, int) -> single numeric consensus m/z

Called once per fragment group, after grouping; the result becomes the group's fragment_mz. Should return NA_real_, not error, when the group has no finite values.
